principle: The 500 figure is a discovery-pool benchmark, not a claim that 500 sources are execution-eligible.
execution_source_policy: Use the maximum number of evidence-qualified Iran-compatible foreign sources plus eligible domestic Iranian sources.
market_intelligence_policy: Retain foreign/incompatible sources for demand and product discovery; check them twice daily when online.
duplicate_policy: One canonical host per scan cycle; duplicates are archived as duplicate candidates, not counted twice.
blacklist_policy: Blacklist sources are archived, never deleted, and excluded from all recommendations.
